$comment: Initial JS per route, gzipped. Checked by scripts/check-bundle-size.mjs.
Ceilings come from Bolum 52.3; this file is the enforcing copy and must not
be raised above them without a decision (EK D.10 - 13, 14).
sharedKb  - chunks every route loads: the React and Next runtime plus
whatever the root layout pulls in. Only moves on a dependency
change, and should be noticed the day it does. Measured 168.1.
Two route classes, because 52.3 already splits LCP the same way: the landing
page is first contact and the thinnest point of the anonymous funnel, while
the editor is reached by a committed user after a deliberate action.
marketing - landing and legal. Server components, currently 0 KB of own
code. ownKb is derived: totalKb minus sharedKb.
app       - editor and generation routes. dnd-kit, React Hook Form and Zod
A route matches the first class whose pattern it hits; anything unmatched is
an app route, so a new route is budgeted strictly until someone says
